blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A lone bettor from Santolan, Pasig City won the P21.6 million Lotto 6/42 jackpot in Thursday night’s draw. The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), in an advisory Friday, said the bettor correctly guessed the winning combination 34-15-19-37-25-38, winning the jackpot of P21,694,699.03. READ: Lotto 6/42: Lone bettor wins P21.69M jackpot on Oct. 29 To claim the check, the bettor must go to PCSO’s main office in Mandaluyong City and present the winning ticket and two ID cards.
